commit_scope: Execution commit identifies trained runtime. Curation HEAD is evidence/prose history, not the training execution; final artifact commit is recorded by Git.

training.coverage_policy: Loss-computed exposure includes trailing partial microbatches; complete-update weight-lineage exposure is separate.

coordinate_check.scope: Sample identities only; not augmentation/model numerical equivalence or exact cursor replay.
